items.Sentence: The treatment system consists of influent screening and grit removal;
The Facility includes a 5 million gallon aerated influent equalization basin and a 3.35 million gallon equalization basin,
biological removal of biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) and nitrogen in aerobic, anoxic, and pre-anoxic basins;
microfiltration through a membrane bioreactor (MBR); the immersed membrane filtration process separates suspended solids ... using a very fine filter (i.e., ultrafilter).

The Permittee uses a proprietary solids removal and digestion process that combines aerobic and anaerobic processes... all solids ... are first passed through a 250 micron rotary drum screen... digested solids are pumped ... dosed with polymer for thickening, and then dewatered in a centrifuge
All solids are then transported for disposal at Redwood Landfill in Marin County or Hay Road Landfill in Solano County.
